title: Q-TENANT-row-isolation: tenant_id on every core table so multi-tenant is stricter isolation, not a rewrite
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** file:seed/worker/migrations/0005_tenant_core.sql
**Status:** open

TENANT-1 put tenant_id on objectives and metrics and scoped the measure step to its own tenant. Extend the same column to items, claims, gate_cards, predictions, outcomes, dispatches, trust_ledger and roles in migration 0005 (additive, guarded for re-run), scope every tick query by tenant, and add the cross-tenant test (a customer's loop can never change the platform's rows). Credentials follow: each binding names its tenant.
